source: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural and physical vectors (countries, populated places, geographic regions, marine areas, rivers and lake centerlines) and Wikidata landmark coordinates
licenseEvidence: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/ (read 2026-09-12): all versions of Natural Earth raster and vector map data are in the public domain; no permission is needed to use them.
qualification: Natural Earth countries, places, regions, seas and rivers with English names, ranks, label zoom levels and Wikidata ids, plus a short list of world-famous landmarks transcribed from Wikidata. Countries anchor at Natural Earth's label point with no boundary; places are unsized points; regions and seas carry their bounding box as the extent; rivers carry their centreline; landmarks are single Wikidata coordinates. Names, ranks and geometry are Natural Earth's and Wikidata's editorial choices, not an official gazetteer.
